Japanese Insurance Sales Compensation
Conceptual and Logical Data Model

How a Japanese life or non-life insurer decides who sold what, what it is worth, when it is paid, and when it is taken back. The model follows the six steps from Data Modeling Made Simple: business model, entities, relationships, actions, attributes, and iteration.

Contents
  1. Business model
  2. Entities (conceptual glossary)
  3. Relationships and the conceptual ER diagram
  4. Actions and policy-event effects
  5. Attributes: the logical model
  6. Iterate: open questions and change log
  7. Appendix: how a yen flows, POC mapping

Naming: English entity names with the romanized Japanese term and kanji. Every entity states its grain, meaning what one row is. Cardinality reads as crow's foot: a bar is "one", a circle is "zero", a fork is "many".

1Business model

Scope: the sales compensation function of a Japanese insurance group with a separate life company and non-life company. In scope: in-house sales staff pay, life and non-life agency commission, bank-sales commission, clawbacks, holds, evaluations, statements, and the tax handling of payments. Out of scope: underwriting, claims assessment, reserving, and customer marketing, except where they feed pay.

Key partnersAgencies and multi-insurer shops, banks and securities firms, car dealers, reinsurers, the FSA and the Life and Non-Life Insurance Associations (Seiho-kyokai 生保協会, Sonpo-kyokai 損保協会), payroll and tax authorities.
Key activitiesRecruit, train and license sellers; appoint agencies; design compensation plans; capture policy events; calculate commission and pay monthly; evaluate rank, tier and points; claw back and reinstate; report to regulators.
Key resourcesRegistered sellers and agency network, product and rate tables, the policy admin system, the compensation engine and ledger, compliance records.
Value propositionSellers and agencies are paid correctly, on time, and explainably for business that stays in force; the insurer pays for quality and persistency, not just volume, and can prove compliance.
Customer relationshipsWith payees: monthly statements, rank reviews, tier and point notices, dispute handling. With policyholders: needs confirmation, comparison, disclosure, cooling-off.
ChannelsIn-house sales staff (eigyo shokuin), exclusive and multi-insurer agencies, bank sales (madohan 窓販), direct and worksite.
Customer segmentsPayees: in-house sellers, life agencies, non-life agencies, banks. Policyholders: individuals, the elderly, corporations.
Cost structureFirst-year and renewal commission, performance pay and bonuses, training guarantees, consumption tax that cannot be credited for unregistered agencies, operations and systems.
Revenue streamsPremium income; the loading (fuka hokenryo 付加保険料) inside it funds commission, so expense profit (hisa-eki 費差益) depends on paying commission well.

Business questions the model must answer

  • What does each payee earn this month, line by line, and which rule version produced each line?
  • Which commission is on hold, why, and when can it be released?
  • What is a seller's ANP, weighted premium and 13 and 25 month persistency, and what rank does that give?
  • What tier or point band does each agency contract hold, and what rates does it unlock next period?
  • When a policy lapses or is cancelled, what is clawed back from whom?
  • Can we reproduce a closed month exactly, and prove each sale was licensed and compliant?

2Entities

Six subject areas group 44 entities. Following the video, people and organizations are the active entities that trigger actions; things and events are passive.

A. Parties and organization

Who sells, who is paid, and who they sell for

EntityKindDefinitionGrainBusiness ownerSource
Insurer (legal entity)
hoken gaisha 保険会社		Person / org (active)A licensed insurance company. Life and non-life are separate legal entities by law (seison-ho kenei kinshi 生損保兼営禁止), so every rule, run, ledger line and statement belongs to exactly one insurer. A group with a life and a non-life company is modeled as two insurers.One row per licensed insurance company.Corporate planningMaster data
Party
torihiki-saki / kankeisha 関係者		Person / org (active), supertypeAny person or organization the business deals with, held once for the whole group. Roles (Seller, Agency, Customer, Payee) hang off Party, so one person who is both a seller and a policyholder is not duplicated. The party master is shared across life and non-life companies; everything that pays or contracts is scoped by insurer.One row per real-world person or organization, shared across the group.Master data managementGroup party master
Person
kojin 個人		Person (subtype of Party)A natural person: seller, policyholder, insured, beneficiary.One row per natural person (subtype of Party).Master data managementGroup party master
Organization
hojin 法人		Organization (subtype of Party)A company, bank, dealer, or other organization, including agencies and corporate policyholders.One row per company, bank, dealer or other organization (subtype of Party).Master data managementGroup party master
Sales organization unit
shisha / eigyosho 支社・営業所		Person / org (active)A node in the insurer's in-house sales hierarchy: head office, regional branch (shisha 支社), sales office (eigyosho 営業所). Office managers' overrides and office bonuses roll up along this tree.One row per org unit per validity range.Sales planningHR / org master
Payee
shiharai-saki 支払先		Person / org (active), supertypeAnyone who can receive compensation. A supertype: an in-house Seller (paid through payroll, with withholding tax and social insurance) or an Agency (paid by statement, with consumption tax). Everything that is paid points at a Payee, so the ledger has one shape for both.One row per party per insurer that can be paid.Sales compensation operationsDerived from Seller and Agency
Seller (solicitor)
boshunin 募集人		Person / org (active)A person registered to solicit insurance. Subtypes by role: in-house sales staff (eigyo shokuin 営業職員), agency staff (dairiten shiyonin 代理店使用人), bank or securities staff (kin'yu kikan boshunin). Only in-house staff are Payees themselves; agency staff earn credit, but the money goes to their Agency.One row per person acting as a solicitor, per validity range.Sales HR / agency managementHR system, agency registration
Agency
dairiten 代理店		Person / org (active)A business that solicits on an insurer's behalf. Types: exclusive life agency, multi-insurer shop (noriai dairiten 乗合代理店), bank or securities firm, corporate in-house agency, car dealer, professional or side-business non-life agency. Paid commission by statement, which carries consumption tax.One row per organization acting as an agency, per validity range.Agency management dept (dairiten-bu 代理店部)Agency master
Customer
keiyakusha / hihokensha 契約者・被保険者		Person / org (active)Policyholder, insured person or beneficiary. Compensation only needs a few facts about them: age at sale (elderly-customer rules), and whether they are a corporation. Keep personal data minimal and masked.One row per party in a customer role.Policy administrationPolicy admin system

B. Contracts and licensing

The permissions that make a sale payable

EntityKindDefinitionGrainBusiness ownerSource
Agency contract
dairiten itaku keiyaku 代理店委託契約		Thing (passive)The appointment between one Insurer and one Agency. It resolves the many-to-many between insurers and agencies, and it carries the compensation plan, tier or point standing, and payment terms that apply to that pair. Unique on insurer, agency and contract start.One row per insurer and agency appointment.Agency management deptAgency contract system
Seller appointment
toroku / shozoku 登録・所属		Thing (associative)A seller's registration to solicit for one specific insurer. A seller at a multi-insurer agency has one appointment per insurer, and a sale is payable only if the appointment for the policy's insurer was valid on the application date.One row per seller per insurer registration.Agency management / complianceRegistration system
Qualification / licence
shikaku / toroku 資格・登録		Thing (passive)A licence or exam a seller holds, with validity dates: life solicitor registration, variable-annuity exam (hengaku 変額), foreign-currency exam (gaika 外貨), non-life basic and product units (songai hoken boshunin shiken 損害保険募集人試験). A sale is payable only if the required qualifications were valid on the application date.One row per seller per qualification per validity range.Compliance / trainingTraining and registration systems

C. Product, policy and sales conduct

What was sold, what happened to it, and how it was sold

EntityKindDefinitionGrainBusiness ownerSource
Product
hoken shohin 保険商品		Thing (passive)A sellable plan from one insurer: term, whole life, endowment, medical, cancer, variable, foreign-currency, auto, fire, earthquake, and so on. Products are versioned because rates change by launch or revision date (kaitei 改定). The base code (often called basecode or shohin kodo 商品コード) identifies the product family; the version adds the revision.One row per product base code per version.Product deptProduct master
Product component (base or rider)
shu-keiyaku / tokuyaku 主契約・特約		Thing (component entity)A coverage that can be attached under a product: the base contract or a rider. A component entity: it does not exist without its product. Commission rates and weights are often set per component, not per product.One row per base or rider component of a product version.Product deptProduct master
Policy
hoken keiyaku 保険契約		Thing (passive)A contract issued by one insurer for one product to one policyholder. The policy is the anchor for credit, persistency and clawback. A conversion (tenkan 転換) creates a new policy that points at the one it replaced.One row per policy number.Policy administrationPolicy admin system
Policy component
keiyaku naiyo 契約内容(主契約・特約)		Thing (component entity)The base coverage or a rider as actually sold on a policy, with its own premium and term. Riders can be added or dropped mid-term, which changes ANP and can create commission or clawback on that component only.One row per base or rider on a policy.Policy administrationPolicy admin system
Policy event
keiyaku ido 契約異動		Event (action record)Something that happened to a policy that can change pay: issue, premium receipt, cooling-off, lapse, reinstatement, conversion, increase or decrease, paid-up, surrender, mid-term cancellation, renewal, claim. Events are append-only and carry two dates: when it was effective and when the system learned of it. Commission is calculated from events, never from the policy's current status.One row per business event on a policy or component, append-only.Policy administrationPolicy admin system feeds
Credit split (shared sale)
kyodo boshu 共同募集		Thing (associative)Who gets credit for a policy and in what share. Resolves the many-to-many between Policy and Seller. Production credit and money can be split differently, so both shares are kept.One row per policy per credited seller per validity range.Sales compensation operationsApplication / agency submission
Sales conduct record
boshu kiroku 募集記録		Thing (passive)Evidence that a sale followed the rules: needs confirmation (iko haaku 意向把握), compare-and-recommend reasons (hikaku suisho 比較推奨), information provision (joho teikyo 情報提供), elderly-customer checks (family present, second visit), bank-sale firewall checks. Missing or failed records put commission on hold.One row per conduct record captured for a policy sale.CompliancePoint-of-sale / compliance systems
Commission disclosure
tesuryo kaiji 手数料開示		Thing (passive)The commission amount or rate disclosed to the customer, mainly for bank-sold savings-type and foreign-currency products. The paid commission should match what was disclosed; a gap is a compliance exception.One row per policy where commission was disclosed.ComplianceBank sales system

D. Compensation rules

Effective-dated plan rules: rates, weights, clawbacks, ranks, tiers, points

EntityKindDefinitionGrainBusiness ownerSource
Compensation plan
hoshu seido / tesuryo kitei 報酬制度・手数料規定		Rule set (passive)A named, versioned set of rules for one insurer and one channel, for example 'Life in-house sales staff FY2026' or 'Non-life agency points FY2026'. Rules below hang off a plan. Rules are effective-dated and never overwritten; a change is a new version.One row per plan per version.Sales compensation designPlan administration
Commission rate rule
tesuryo ritsu 手数料率		Rule (passive)The rate that turns premium into commission: by product or component, policy year, premium mode, payment pattern (front-loaded or level), and tier. First-year (shotesuryo 初年度手数料) and renewal (keizoku tesuryo 継続手数料) are separate rows.One row per rate cell (plan, product or component, policy year, mode, tier) per version.Sales compensation designPlan administration
Production weight
kansan ritsu 換算率		Rule (passive)The factor that converts premium into weighted production credit (kansan hokenryo 換算保険料), so that a protection product counts for more than a savings product of the same premium. Used for in-house rank and performance pay.One row per plan, product and premium mode per version.Sales compensation designPlan administration
Clawback rule
modoshi / reinyu kitei 戻入規定		Rule (passive)How much paid commission is taken back when a policy ends early, by event type and policy month. Cooling-off reverses 100%; lapse and surrender follow a declining scale; reinstatement within the window gives it back; paid-up, reduction and conversion have their own treatment.One row per plan, event type and policy-month band per version.Sales compensation designPlan administration
Rank level
shikaku / tokyu 資格・等級		Rule (passive)One step of the in-house seller ladder, with the thresholds to reach or keep it (weighted premium, policy count, persistency, qualifications) and the pay that goes with it (fixed pay band, performance pay rate).One row per rank step in a plan.Sales HRPlan administration
Agency tier / point rule
dairiten hyoka kijun 代理店評価基準		Rule (passive)How an agency's standing is scored: for life agencies, tier thresholds (ANP, persistency, seller count, audit); for non-life agencies, the point system (dairiten tesuryo pointo seido) with weighted metrics for volume, growth, loss ratio and quality, plus knock-out conditions.One row per plan, metric and band.Agency management deptPlan administration
In-house pay rule
kyuyo kitei 給与規定		Rule (passive)Rules for in-house pay that are not commission rates: the training-salary guarantee for new hires (ikusei-kyu 育成給) and how it tapers, trainer and manager allowances (shido teate 指導手当), office bonuses (eigyosho shorei 営業所奨励) based on office results, and other fixed allowances.One row per plan, pay-item type and band per version.Sales HRPlan administration
Tax and deduction rule
zeiritsu / gensen kitei 税率・源泉規定		Rule (passive)Effective-dated tax rules applied to payments: consumption tax rate on agency commission (10%), the input-tax credit percentage for unregistered agencies during the invoice transition (80%, then 50%, then 0), and withholding on salesperson fees paid to individuals (gaikoin hoshu 外交員報酬: monthly amount above 120,000 yen times 10.21%). Payroll withholding and social insurance stay in the payroll system.One row per tax type, condition and validity range.Finance / taxTax master

E. Performance and evaluation

Measured results and the frozen evaluations built on them

EntityKindDefinitionGrainBusiness ownerSource
Performance subject
hyoka taisho 評価対象		Thing (supertype)Whatever a result is measured for: a seller, an agency contract or a sales office. A supertype so measures and cohorts can point at one real foreign key instead of a free-text type plus id.One row per measurable seller, agency contract or org unit.Sales planningDerived from Seller, Agency contract, Sales org unit
Performance measure
gyoseki 業績		Result (derived)A measured number for one payee or seller in one period: ANP (nenkansan hokenryo 年換算保険料), APE, weighted premium, policy count, in-force premium, loss ratio, quality score. Each is a ratio or total with a stated numerator (bunshi 分子) and denominator (bunbo 分母).One row per subject, period, measure and run.Sales compensation operationsCalculated
Persistency cohort
keizoku-ritsu 継続率		Result (derived)Persistency for a group of policies issued in the same month, measured at 13 and 25 months, by seller, agency or office. Counts or premium can be the base. Feeds rank, tier, points and quality.One row per subject, issue month, checkpoint and basis, frozen per period.Sales compensation operationsCalculated
Rank assessment
shikaku satei 資格査定		Result (frozen evaluation)The result of a periodic (often half-yearly) rank review for an in-house seller: the rank before, the rank after, and the measures it used. Once approved it is frozen and drives pay for the next period.One row per seller per review period.Sales HRCalculated, then approved
Agency rating
dairiten hyoka 代理店評価		Result (frozen evaluation)The tier (life) or point total and band (non-life) an agency contract earned for a period, frozen before it sets next period's commission rates. Restatements create a new rating version; they never edit the frozen one.One row per agency contract per rating period per version.Agency management deptCalculated, then approved

F. Calculation and payment

Calendar, runs, the immutable ledger, holds, statements and payroll

EntityKindDefinitionGrainBusiness ownerSource
Exchange rate
kawase reto 為替レート		Thing (reference)The insurer's own published rates per currency and day (for example TTM, TTS, TTB), with each type used for premium receipts on foreign-currency policies (gaika-date hoken). The rate applied to a receipt is copied onto the Policy event, so this table is used to validate and explain that rate, never to reprice past lines.One row per insurer, currency pair, rate type and date.Treasury / product administrationInsurer's published daily rates
Booking period
keijo-tsuki 計上月		Thing (calendar)A month for one insurer, with its cut-off date (shimebi 締め日), payment date and close status. An event belongs to the period whose cut-off it falls before, which is why a late-month sale can book to next month.One row per insurer per booking month.Finance / compensation opsCompensation calendar
Source load status
shime-bi deta torikomi 締め日データ取込		Thing (control record)Whether each source feed (policy events, premium receipts, credit splits, qualifications, conduct records) has fully arrived up to the cut-off date (shimebi 締め日) for an insurer's month. A final run cannot start until every required source is complete; late data books to the next month.One row per insurer, booking month and source system.Compensation operationsIngestion
Period close header
shime kakutei 締め確定		Thing (control record)Proof that one insurer's month was closed: which final run was posted, how many lines, and the total, even when both are zero. It tells a real 'closed with nothing to pay' apart from 'never posted'. Physically, the close also freezes a copy of that month's posted lines so later corrections can't change it; that copy is an implementation of this entity, not a separate business concept.One row per insurer per closed month, even when totals are zero.Finance / compensation opsCompensation engine
Calculation run
keisan jikko 計算実行		Event (process)One execution of the calculation for one insurer and period, either a trial (shisan 試算) or final. Only a final, approved run posts lines to the ledger. Re-running the same inputs must produce the same result.One row per calculation execution.Compensation operationsCompensation engine
Commission ledger line
tesuryo meisai 手数料明細		Thing (immutable ledger)One posted money amount for one payee: first-year or renewal commission, performance pay, bonus, override, clawback, reinstatement, or manual adjustment. Lines are never updated or deleted; a correction is a new reversing line that points at the original. Each line is an original, a reversal of another line, or an adjustment to a line in a closed month.One row per posted amount per payee, append-only.Compensation operations / financeCalculated
Commission hold
shiharai horyu 支払保留		Thing (passive)A reason a line cannot be paid yet: missing or expired qualification, missing needs-confirmation or compare-and-recommend record, elderly-check gap, suspended contract, disputed split. The line stays in the ledger; the hold controls payment.One row per hold placed on a ledger line.Compliance / compensation opsCalculated rules + manual
Agency payment statement
shiharai meisaisho / shiire meisaisho 支払明細書・仕入明細書		Thing (document)The monthly statement to one agency for one insurer: net commission, consumption tax at 10%, and the invoice-system treatment. When the insurer self-bills, the statement is the buyer-issued purchase statement (shiire meisaisho) that the agency confirms.One row per insurer, agency contract and month.Finance / taxGenerated at close
Statement status event
shiire meisaisho kakunin 仕入明細書確認		Event (action record)Each status the agency gives a payment statement (shiire meisaisho): issued, confirmed or disputed. Append-only; the latest event is the current status, and the history shows who confirmed what and when.One row per status change per statement.Agency management / financeAgency portal
Settlement
shiharai jisseki 支払実績		Event (action record)What was actually paid against each ledger line, and on which statement or payroll run. Kept apart from the statement because a statement can be paid in part, netted, or carried over.One row per ledger line per payment.FinancePayment / AP system
Payroll export
kyuyo renkei 給与連携		Thing (document)The pay items handed to payroll for an in-house seller each month: fixed pay, performance pay, allowances, clawback deductions. Payroll then applies income tax withholding (gensen choshu 源泉徴収) and social insurance (shakai hoken 社会保険).One row per seller, month and pay item.HR / payrollGenerated at close

3Relationships

The conceptual diagram shows entities and verbs only, no attributes. Scroll inside the frame to see it all.

Special relationship types used

TypeMeaningWhere it appears in this domain
AssociativeResolves a many-to-many and carries its own facts.Agency contract between Insurer and Agency; Credit split between Policy and Seller; Seller appointment between Seller and Insurer.
Inheritance (supertype and subtype)A parent with children that share its key.Party splits into Person and Organization; Seller has in-house, agency staff and bank staff subtypes.
RoleThe same party acting in different capacities.A person can be a Seller and a Customer; an organization can be an Agency and a corporate policyholder.
Component (dependent)Cannot exist without its parent.Product component under Product; Policy component under Policy.
AggregationA collection of related things, not a calculation.A Compensation plan collects its rate, weight, clawback, rank and tier rules.
RecursiveAn entity related to itself.Org unit parent and child; Policy converted into a new Policy; Ledger line reversed by another line.

What each policy event does to pay

This is the core of Japanese sales compensation: the same event moves four different numbers in different ways. Exact treatment varies by company and plan, so the rule tables hold the numbers; this matrix shows the typical shape.

EventCommissionANP / in-forcePersistencyClawback
Issue (seiritsu 成立)Opens first-year commission; front-loaded plans may pay at issueAddsOpens a cohortStarts the clock
Premium received (nyukin 入金)First-year or renewal commission by policy monthNo changeKeeps policy in forceNone
Cooling-off (kuringu ofu クーリング・オフ)All commission reversedRemoved as if never soldExcluded from the cohort100% reversal
Lapse (shikko 失効)Commission stopsRemoves from in-forceCounts as not persistingPer clawback scale
Reinstatement (fukkatsu 復活)Commission resumesBack in forceCounts as persisting if inside the windowClawback given back
Conversion (tenkan 転換)New policy pays on the new contract; credit often only on the net increaseNet change onlyOld policy usually not counted as a lapseCompany rule, often reduced
Increase / decrease (zogaku / gengaku 増額・減額)Commission on the added or removed premiumPlus or minus the changeUsually unaffectedPartial clawback on decrease
Paid-up (haraizumi 払済)Commission stopsRemoves premiumOften counted as not persistingPer rule
Surrender (kaiyaku 解約)Commission stopsRemoves from in-forceCounts as not persistingPer clawback scale
Mid-term cancel, non-life (chuto kaiyaku 中途解約)Commission refunded on returned premiumRemovesNot usedPro-rata or short-period rate
Renewal, non-life (koshin 更新)New-year commission at the current point bandRenewal premiumFeeds renewal-rate metricNone
Claim (hokenkin seikyu 保険金請求)No commissionNo changeNo changeNone, but feeds the loss ratio for points

5Attributes: the logical model

Attributes with keys, data types, constraints and history tracking. Diagrams show each subject area in full plus the neighbouring entities it points at (key only).

Modeling conventions

ConventionRule
Insurer on every money rowRules, runs, ledger lines, statements and closes all carry the insurer. The insurer comes from the product, never from the agency or seller, because a multi-insurer agency sells for several companies.
Effective-dated rulesRates, weights, clawbacks, ranks and tiers have valid-from and valid-to dates and a version. A mid-year change is a new version. Look-ups use the application date, not the run date.
Append-only events and ledgerPolicy events and commission lines are never updated or deleted. Corrections are new rows that point at what they correct.
Two time ranges where it mattersParty, contract and credit data keep both when it was true in the business and when we recorded it, so a closed month can be replayed exactly. Which entities get them is listed in the logical design decisions below.
Frozen yardsticksPersistency cohorts, rank assessments, agency ratings and office results are frozen at close; late corrections create a new version for the next period, not a silent change.
Yen with no fractionsMoney is held as whole yen. Rounding happens at a stated level (line, statement) with a stated method; the primary seller in a shared sale takes the remainder.
Data typesFollowing the video: prefer enumerations and booleans to free text, timestamps for when something was recorded, and dates for business dates such as application date, cut-off and valid-from.

Logical design decisions

How every entity keeps history, how it is keyed, and which rules must hold across entities. These turn the conceptual model into something a physical design can implement without guessing.

History classes

ClassNameRuleEntities
BTBitemporalTwo time ranges: valid_from/valid_to (true in the business) and recorded_from/recorded_to (when we knew it). Rows are never updated; a change closes the old row's recorded_to and inserts a new one. Lets a closed month be replayed exactly as it was known at its load cut-off.Party, Person, Organization, Sales organization unit, Payee, Seller (solicitor), Agency, Customer, Agency contract, Seller appointment, Qualification / licence, Credit split (shared sale), Performance subject
VRVersioned ruleBelongs to an approved Compensation plan version and carries effective_from/effective_to inside that version's window. A change is a new plan version, never an edit. Look-ups use the policy's application date.Product, Product component (base or rider), Compensation plan, Commission rate rule, Production weight, Clawback rule, Rank level, Agency tier / point rule, In-house pay rule
AOAppend-onlyInsert-only fact with recorded_at. Corrections are new rows pointing at what they correct. No updates, no deletes.Policy, Policy component, Policy event, Sales conduct record, Commission disclosure, Period close header, Calculation run, Commission ledger line, Commission hold, Agency payment statement, Statement status event, Settlement, Payroll export
FSFrozen snapshotComputed once per period and frozen at close, with version and frozen_at. A late correction creates a new version that applies from the next open period.Performance measure, Persistency cohort, Rank assessment, Agency rating
EREffective-dated referenceSet by law or regulation rather than by a pay plan (tax rates, withholding bands). Effective dates only, not tied to a plan version, with the legal basis recorded on each row.Tax and deduction rule, Exchange rate
CSCurrent state with auditSmall reference or control rows that change status through a controlled workflow; every status change is also written to an audit trail.Insurer (legal entity), Booking period, Source load status

Data type standards

Kind of valueLogical typeRule
IdentifierSTRINGOpaque surrogate, never reused, never meaningful. Business keys sit beside it as unique constraints.
Money in yenDECIMAL(18,0)Whole yen. Never FLOAT. Sign carries meaning: reversals are negative.
Money in policy currencyDECIMAL(18,2)Foreign-currency premiums, always stored next to the yen amount and the applied rate.
Rate or percentageDECIMAL(9,6)Stored as a fraction (0.35 = 35%). Never a string, never an integer percent.
ShareDECIMAL(5,4)Credit and commission shares. Shares per policy add up to exactly 1.0000.
FX rateDECIMAL(12,6)The rate the insurer actually applied on that receipt, not a market rate.
Business dateDATEApplication, issue, cover start, cut-off, valid_from. Business dates are in JST and have no time part.
Recorded timeTIMESTAMPWhen the system learned something (recorded_at, recorded_from). Stored in UTC, shown in JST.
MonthDATE (first of month)Booking month (keijo-tsuki), issue month. Always the 1st, so month arithmetic stays simple.
Code listENUMClosed lists only. Anything a business user can extend (product codes, rank codes, pay items) is a reference table, not an enum.

Cross-entity constraints

Rules that a single column cannot express. Each one should become an automated data-quality check that blocks a final run.

WhereRule
Policyinsurer_id must equal Product.insurer_id. The insurer comes from the product, never from the agency or seller.
Policyagency_contract_id is required when channel is AGENCY or BANK, and must be empty for IN_HOUSE.
PolicyStatus is not stored as truth. It is derived from the latest Policy event as of a given date.
PolicyEventpremium_amount_jpy = premium_amount x applied_fx_rate, rounded to whole yen; applied_fx_rate = 1 for JPY.
CreditSplitFor each policy and any date, credit_share and commission_share each add up to exactly 1.0000, and only one row is is_primary.
CreditSplitEvery seller on the split must have a valid Seller appointment for the policy's insurer on the application date.
SellerAppointment / QualificationNo two rows for the same key may have overlapping valid ranges.
CommissionRateRule and other ruleseffective_from and effective_to must sit inside the plan version's window. Within a plan, rule ranges for the same key may not overlap and must leave no gaps.
CommissionLineline_action = ORIGINAL means reverses_line_id is empty; REVERSAL or ADJUSTMENT means it is required.
CommissionLineFor foreign-currency policies, fx_rate_type on an ORIGINAL line equals the plan's commission_fx_basis, and applied_fx_rate is that rate type's published rate on the receipt date.
CommissionLineA reversal or clawback reuses the original line's yen amount and applied_fx_rate. It is never repriced at a current rate.
CommissionLineThe reversals linked to a line can never add up to more than the line itself (in absolute yen).
CommissionLineinsurer_id on the line equals the insurer of the product, the period and the payee.
CommissionLineA line can be posted only to an OPEN period; corrections to a CLOSED period become ADJUSTMENT lines in the next open period.
CommissionHoldA hold is released at most once. Release is a write-once column, and releasing never changes the line's amount.
PeriodCloseEvery closed period has exactly one close row, including periods with zero lines. line_count and total_amount_jpy must equal the posted lines.
PaymentStatementnet_commission_jpy equals the sum of the agency's posted lines for that insurer and month; consumption tax is rounded once per statement per tax rate.
PaymentStatementA statement counts as a valid invoice for input-tax credit only once its latest status is CONFIRMED or DEEMED_CONFIRMED. DEEMED_CONFIRMED can only be written after confirmation_deadline, and only if no DISPUTED event exists for that version.
CalculationRunA FINAL run may start only when every Source load status row for its period is COMPLETE up to the cut-off date.
SettlementPaid amounts against a line never exceed the line's amount; a line is unpaid, part paid or paid only by summing its settlements.

Changes from the v0.2 draft

EntityChange and why
SellerRemoved current_rank_code. The rank lives only in Rank assessment; a copy on the seller goes stale and gets used by mistake.
CommissionLineRemoved payment_status. The ledger is append-only, so status cannot live on it; it is derived from Settlement.
CommissionLineAdded policy_component_id, so a rider can be clawed back on its own, and rule_version as a hard link to the rule that priced the line.
PolicyEventAdded application_date, booking period, applied_fx_rate, source_system and premium_currency, so the event alone is enough to price and route it.
CompensationPlanMade each row one plan version (comp_plan_id is a version), with plan_code as the stable identity. RankLevel and AgencyTierRule now version through it.
PerformanceMeasure / PersistencyCohortReplaced the polymorphic subject_type plus subject_id with a Performance subject supertype, so the foreign key can be enforced.
PaymentStatementAdded statement_version and confirmation_deadline, and moved the confirmation status (ISSUED, CONFIRMED, DEEMED_CONFIRMED, DISPUTED) to an append-only Statement status event; the latest event wins.
All bitemporal entitiesAdded recorded_from and recorded_to; their primary key now includes valid_from and recorded_from.
All entitiesAdded standard lineage columns: source_system and load_batch_id on loaded data, and calc_run_id on everything the engine produces.

6Iterate

The video's last step: the model is never finished. These are the open points for the next pass.

AreaOpen question
DomainShould conversion credit be modeled as its own rule table (net increase vs full credit) or as a parameter on the clawback rule?
DomainDo we need a separate entity for office and manager overrides, or is the org unit plus a line type enough?
DomainElderly age threshold (70 or 75, plus family-present rules) differs by company; keep it as a parameter on the plan.
POC mappingMap each entity to its current Databricks table, and list the gaps (Databricks Bot, read-only).

Logical questions answered in v0.3

AreaQuestionDecision
LogicalPolymorphic subject on Performance measure and Persistency cohort: keep, or split into seller, agency and office tables?Neither. Add a Performance subject supertype with seller, agency contract and org unit subtypes. Measure and cohort keep one shape, and the foreign key is real.
LogicalWhich entities need two time ranges versus simple valid-from and valid-to?Two time ranges for anything that is loaded from another system and can be corrected after the fact: parties, org units, payees, sellers, agencies, contracts, appointments, qualifications and credit splits. Rules only need effective dates plus plan versioning, because they change through approval, not through corrections. Events and the ledger are append-only and need recorded_at only.
LogicalKey strategy: surrogate keys everywhere with business keys as unique constraints?Yes. Opaque surrogates everywhere, business keys as unique constraints, and for history tables the key is surrogate plus valid_from plus recorded_from. The one exception is the ledger line, whose id is a deterministic hash of its business key, so reruns produce the same id and stay idempotent.

v0.311 Oct 2026Logical layer by Dataexpert: history class per entity (bitemporal, versioned rule, append-only, frozen snapshot, current state), key strategy and business keys, data type standards, 16 cross-entity constraints, Performance subject supertype, Statement status event, rider-level ledger grain, deterministic ledger ids, and removal of stored status that broke immutability.
